evidence.cmd:
python3 - << 'PY'
import re
from pathlib import Path
labels = ["Candidates", "Admitted", "Rejected", "Spot-check"]
for p in sorted(Path("corpus/lessons").glob("round-*.md")):
    text = p.read_text()
    lines = text.splitlines()
    line_start = [lab for lab in labels if re.search(rf"^{re.escape(lab)}:", text, re.M)]
    anywhere = [lab for lab in labels if f"{lab}:" in text]
    inline = [lab for lab in anywhere if lab not in line_start]
    absent = [lab for lab in labels if lab not in anywhere]
    gate = [i for i, ln in enumerate(lines, 1) if ln.startswith("## Gate")]
    print(f"{p.as_posix()} h1={lines[0][2:]} gate_lines={gate or 0}")
    print("  line_start=" + (", ".join(line_start) or "none"))
    print("  inline=" + (", ".join(inline) or "none"))
    print("  absent=" + (", ".join(absent) or "none"))
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines, 1):
        if re.search(r"candidates|admitted|rejected|spot-check", ln, re.I) and not any(f"{lab}:" in ln for lab in labels):
            print(f"  prose_not_field={i}:{ln}")
PY
